migration_and_rollback.projection_note: Rollback restores admission-key insertion before explicit selected-signature pruning. No wire, public API, authority, benchmark or promotion state changes are involved.

title: Prune unselected verified-binding admission keys in explicit compilation

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Reduce explicit selected-signature admission staging inside the existing compile_relation_blocks owner. When a verified binding's RelationSignature is outside an explicit requested set, do not retain its exact admission key because no cross-plane ForestEdge of that unrequested signature reaches binding admission. Preserve discover-all admission, exact selected cross-plane ForestEdge refusal/admission, verified_binding_count source semantics, include_verified_bindings=False behavior, validation precedence and the separation between admission identity and fact-record storage. Do not add another binding index, cache, backend, registry, compiler or public API.

audit.gpu_87_state: GPU-87 already stopped source/target index and binding-record tuple staging for verified bindings outside an explicit requested signature set, but included_binding_keys was still populated before that pruning boundary.
audit.cross_plane_edge_control_flow: A directed cross-plane ForestEdge reaches exact binding-key membership only when requested_set is None or its own RelationSignature is explicitly requested. Under explicit selection, unrequested cross-plane edge signatures continue before binding admission and therefore cannot consume admission keys from unrequested binding signatures.
audit.selected_admission_proof: For an explicitly requested cross-plane signature, matching verified bindings pass the same RelationSignature filter before their exact source-plane/source-node/target-plane/target-node/relation key is inserted, so exact admission remains available for every edge that can reach the check.
audit.discover_all_boundary: When requested_set is None the filter is inactive, so every included verified binding still contributes its exact admission key and record as before.
audit.false_policy_boundary: When include_verified_bindings is False the key set remains empty, so selected or discover-all cross-plane Forest relations still fail closed before fact materialization.
audit.receipt_boundary: verified_binding_count remains the independent source count len(snapshot.bindings) when bindings are included and zero otherwise; admission-key pruning does not reinterpret it as a selected count.
audit.error_precedence: Hyperedge validation and endpoint-completeness checks still precede binding staging. Every included binding still constructs its RelationSignature before explicit pruning; the moved set insertion itself had no independent validation or refusal behavior.
audit.safe_deletion: Move the existing explicit signature filter directly after RelationSignature construction and before included_binding_keys.add. Keep included_binding_keys separate from binding_records rather than merging admission identity with fact storage.

production.change: Move the existing explicit requested-signature refusal ahead of exact admission-key insertion. Unselected verified bindings now retain neither source/target index tuples nor admission keys; selected and discover-all paths retain the same exact key shape and fact records.

coverage: An explicitly selected cross-plane relation is admitted by its exact included verified binding.
An explicitly selected unrelated same-plane relation prunes the unselected cross-plane Forest edge even when verified bindings are excluded.
include_verified_bindings=False refuses a selected observed cross-plane relation before fact materialization.
verified_binding_count remains the complete source binding count under explicit selected-signature pruning.
Discover-all continues to materialize all observed relation families and requires exact included bindings for cross-plane Forest relations.
focused_existing_contract.reason_no_new_test_file: The change is a control-flow reorder inside the existing selected-pruning contract surface. Existing focused integration contracts pin every externally observable admission/refusal and receipt boundary affected by the move; a tracking-set test would couple tests to an internal container implementation without adding semantic coverage.

semantic_invariants.discover_all: When signatures is None, every included verified binding still contributes exact admission identity, is discovered and can be compiled as before.
semantic_invariants.binding_admission: Every cross-plane ForestEdge that can reach admission under explicit selection still checks the exact selected verified-binding key; unrequested edge signatures are pruned before the check and no longer justify unrelated key retention.
semantic_invariants.verified_binding_count: The receipt remains a source count: len(snapshot.bindings) when include_verified_bindings is True and zero when False, independent of explicit signature selection.
semantic_invariants.refusal_precedence: Endpoint completeness and retained-hyperedge refusal remain ahead of binding staging; include_verified_bindings=False and missing exact selected bindings still fail before fact materialization.
semantic_invariants.evidence_dag: Selected binding digest/evidence alternatives and selected Forest evidence semantics are unchanged; only unreachable admission keys for unselected binding signatures are no longer retained.
semantic_invariants.scalar_observers: Boolean remains True and natural remains unit 1 per deduplicated semantic coordinate.
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot remain authoritative; compiled tensor relation blocks remain regenerable computational views.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, compatibility facade, wire schema, benchmark schema, promotion or authority contract changes.

result.summary: Explicit selected-signature compilation no longer retains exact admission keys for verified bindings whose signatures cannot reach cross-plane ForestEdge admission. Selected exact admission, discover-all behavior, source receipt counting and fail-closed binding exclusion remain in the same canonical compiler owner.

verification.static_diff: GPU-87 closure..implementation head is exactly one commit touching daedalus/twin/relation_compiler.py (+2/-2), solely moving the existing explicit-signature filter before included_binding_keys.add.

bounded_next_step: GPU-89 only: audit discovered-signature staging under explicit requested signatures. In explicit mode selected is already the canonical requested tuple, yet selected binding and same-plane edge paths still add their signatures to discovered even though that set is consumed only by discover-all. Determine whether those explicit-mode insertions can be deleted without changing discover-all relation discovery, hyperedge/edge refusal precedence, endpoint-completeness checks or receipt semantics. Prefer a small conditional deletion in the existing compiler; do not add a lazy discovery abstraction, second set owner, cache, backend or compiler.
